title: The Will of Bellwether Lane
author: O. M. Ashgrove
blurb: Astrid Whitlock, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
